requirements.name: 1 validity
requirements.detail: solids 1, shells 1, closed True, valid True, strict True, faces 8

requirements.name: 1 extent
requirements.detail: projected span (Y) 900.000000 mm vs spec 900.000 (diff 0.00e+00); volume 1206170.742 mm3 (cap adds 41890.881; OCCT default integration gives 1206170.742)

requirements.name: 2 locked outline
requirements.detail: max outermost lip deviation 9.07e-11 mm over 202 cut planes; outline-to-surface max 4.78e-12 mm

requirements.name: 3 joins G1
requirements.detail: 4 edges, 1596 samples: gap 2.73e-12 mm, angle 2.98e-11 deg; curvature mismatch 4.344e-12 /mm (cross-join normal curvature 4.340e-12 /mm); closest sample to an edge end 6.8e-08 mm, 164 samples near collapsed corners not judged

requirements.name: 3 cap seams G1
requirements.detail: 2 edges between curved cap faces: gap 2.15e-16 mm, angle 0.00e+00 deg, curvature mismatch 1.491e-16 /mm

requirements.name: 4 section rule
requirements.detail: 48 cuts (0 failed to trace); thick zone min radius 0.00816932 mm at x/c 0.95 (20 of 20 below 0.4); thin zone min ratio 0.003955 at x/c 0.99758219, t 0.05 mm (28 of 28 below 0.9); 42 of the failing cuts cross the lip more than 60 deg from square; bending reversals 0 on 0 cuts

requirements.name: 4b lip-normal radius (informational)
requirements.detail: radius across the lip, perpendicular to the locked outline, at each cut's lip point; thick zone min 0.04579 mm at x/c 0.95 (10 below 0.4); thin zone min ratio 0.09632 at x/c 0.96038337 (22 below 0.9)

requirements.name: 5 whole-cap map
requirements.detail: worst point radius 0.0385296 mm at x/c 0.960383, t 0.8 mm, margin -0.3615 mm; tightest 8.105e-08 mm at x/c 1; points within 0.05 mm of collapsed corners not judged (grid reaches 4.3e-05 mm; worst there 1.47 mm, score 48.2)

requirements.name: 6 TE closure
requirements.detail: sharp point; right (+Y): closes True, 0.02 mm before TE: t 0.00436, section min R 2.589e-06, ratio 0.0012; principal R within 0.1 mm of the TE point min 0.0005529; left (-Y): closes True, 0.02 mm before TE: t 0.00436, section min R 2.589e-06, ratio 0.0012; principal R within 0.1 mm of the TE point min 0.0005529
